title: bug: isolated CB3 test selection hits a fixture TDZ
description: With the approved env -i Node 24 prefix, `node --test --test-name-pattern='^CB3' scripts/tests/local-runner.test.mjs` fails with ReferenceError: Cannot access 'transferRefused' before initialization (CB3:3033, const defined later), plus an unhandled rejection. Selecting all CB rows passes. Move/initialize the fixture safely so narrow CB3 and mutation runs fail only on behavior, retaining all assertions.

implementationPlan.note: Baseline 338 tests/337 pass/1 skip. ^CB3 alone reproduced the TDZ. Added CB7; RED: fail 1, AssertionError carrying child's "Cannot access 'transferRefused' before initialization". Dirty .moe task files belong to others, untouched.

implementationPlan.description: GREEN: hoist the fixture in place. In the CQ-R09c section of scripts/tests/local-runner.test.mjs, replace the top-level `const transferRefused = code => error => <predicate>;` (under the comment 'A surfaced error is a fixed code whose message carries no path, guest text or byte.') with a function declaration at the SAME position: `function transferRefused(code) { return error => <predicate>; }`, where <predicate> is copied byte-for-byte from the current const (do not retype the regex). Extend the existing comment with the non-obvious why, e.g. '... Hoisted (a function, not a const): CB3, above, uses it, and a row selected alone by name starts before this line is evaluated.' Function declarations and ESM imports are initialized before the module body runs, so this is order-independent for CB3 and every current or future earlier user; moving the const up would protect only rows placed after its new spot. Do NOT move or rename it, and do not touch any of its ~45 call sites, any CB3 statement or any other row. Why it happens (verified on Node 24, and 22 = engines floor): node:test starts a name-matched top-level row synchronously inside its test() call when the root slot is free, and filtered rows no longer occupy the slot, so CB3's synchronous prefix (transferRefused('TRANSFER_DIGEST_MISMATCH') is evaluated as an argument, after framingCheck.run(...) already started) runs while the module is still evaluating; the file has no top-level await and its root before() hook (agent-session section) is registered after CB3. Then run P node --test --test-name-pattern='^CB3' scripts/tests/local-runner.test.mjs (1 pass, 0 fail, no 'before initialization' or unhandledRejection text) and P ... --test-name-pattern='^CB7' (pass).
implementationPlan.note: transferRefused hoisted in place to a function declaration; predicate byte-identical. ^CB3 and ^CB7 alone 1/1 green, no TDZ text.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: (1) Move the const above the CB section: fixes CB3 but leaves any user above its new position exposed and pulls the fixture out of its R09c section. Rejected in favor of hoisting in place. (2) A root before() at the top of the file so every row awaits before its body runs: covers the whole class but relies on node:test scheduling internals and changes how all 199 rows start. Rejected. (3) Change CB3 to assert.rejects(() => framingCheck.run(...)): only hides the orphaned-promise symptom and edits an assertion, which the task forbids. Rejected. (4) A module-level typeof transferRefused guard: guards one binding, not CB3's behavior. Rejected in favor of the child-process row, which runs the exact repro.
